mapper.update: update share set show = #{status} where share_id = #{shareID}
mapper.select: select * from share left join share_replenish on share.share_id = share_replenish.share_id left join share_photo_set on share.share_id = share_photo_set.share_id
select * from share_interaction, user where share_id = ${shareId} and share_interaction.user_id = user.user_id
select name from user where user_id = (select user_id from share where share_id = ${shareId})
mapper.insert: insert into share_interaction (share_id, user_id, detail, send_date) values (#{shareID}, #{userID}, #{detail}, #{sendTime})
mapper.update: update share_replenish set like_num = like_num + 1 where share_id = #{shareId}
mapper.select: select * from share a, share_photo_set b where a.share_id = b.share_id group by photo_path
